correctness.summary: The degree-sum upper bound follows from one degree-(q-1) b-vertex per color and positive degree on all remaining vertices. Two explicit constructions cover the sparse and dense cycle-rank regimes, and inversion yields the threshold formula. Equality in the sparse degree-sum bound forces the stated leaf-completion structure. Exhaustive checks through order 7 and direct witness checks through order 30 agree.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Irving--Manlove supplies the high-degree necessity, while Kouider--Maheo and the 2018 survey record a size-only square-root bound. Searches across cyclomatic/cycle-rank/excess and joint order-size terminology did not locate the exact connected extremum, threshold formula, or sparse equality family. A 2026 preprint located in current-status checking concerns independence/chromatic-number bounds instead.

value.summary: The result gives an exact b-chromatic extremum for every feasible pair of order and cycle rank, converts it to a closed minimum-order realization threshold, and identifies all sparse threshold extremals. It sharpens the classical size-only counting bound by exploiting connectedness.

limitations: Dense-regime minimum-order equality graphs are not classified.
The full text of Kouider and Maheo (2002) was not inspected; its relevant size/order statements were checked through the 2018 survey.
The 2026 Zaker preprint was inspected at abstract level only.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; differently indexed literature remains a residual risk.
Finite computation supports but does not replace the proof.
